Package com.openvireo.core.java

package com.openvireo.core.java
The API for Java, without coroutines: J<Object> wrappers (JOvClient, JAccount, JVault, ...) whose suspend methods return CompletableFuture, JOv (every free function as a static), JRecords (records with unsigned fields), JErrors, and the future-based Host interfaces with JHosts and JDefaultHosts. Generated from the binding on every build, so it can't drift from it.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.openvireo.core
    The binding itself, generated by UniFFI from the ov-ffi crate: OvClient, Account, Vault, ServiceAccount, SelfHosted, the records and enums they take and return, the Host interfaces (HttpTransport, SecureStore, BlobCache, Clock, LogSink), OvException and the free functions (crypto, share links, TOTP, OPAQUE).
    com.openvireo.core.hosts
    Ready-made Host parts and defaultHost(...), so a program needs no glue: JavaNetHttpTransport, UrlConnectionTransport, MemoryStore, FileCache, MemoryCache, SystemClock, JulLogSink.
